title: UpdateOp
description: One targeted bulk update (POST /api/v1/exchange/updates, the machine form of the XLSX workbook). Which ops, entities and fields a receiver applies is its own capability: an op it cannot apply yet is answered unsupported_until_1d, and an op on an entity it keeps no rows of is answered rejected whatever its key (never unknown_key). Do not send permit ops to a 1.2.0 reader.

key.description: job: JB; task: external_task_id (TSK), synthetic key, or "<system>|<external_task_id>"; pole: candidate_key or "JB|pole_identifier"; violation: "<pole key>|<code>"; hold: JB; permit: the permit number, or "JB…|permit_number" when a number repeats.

value.description: Ignored for clear. On update a blank value (null or whitespace) is answered unchanged and the literal string CLEAR is a clear (the workbook rule, applied to JSON too); a non-scalar value is answered rejected.

program.description: Phase 1f program key; null => the scope's program.
